messages.text:
I have enough behavior to implement the core now.

I’m going to add a focused Python CLI with manual Clap-like parsing, standard-library ZIP password checks for ZipCrypto, and lightweight AES password verifier support for archives that expose WinZip AES metadata.

commands.commandLine:
"C:\\Program Files\\PowerShell\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command "@'
import zipfile, pathlib
for p in pathlib.Path('rust-reference/test-files').glob('*.zip'):
    z=zipfile.ZipFile(p)
    print(p)
    for i,info in enumerate(z.infolist()):
        print(i, info.filename, 'flag', hex(info.flag_bits), 'comp', info.compress_type, 'extra', info.extra.hex())
'@ | python -"
